text: Program Description Overview The program is designed in a way that students are able to acquire theoretical as well as hands-on knowledge related to business administration, make use of managerial concepts together with computer software, data analysis application, and statistical packages relevant to business environment to organize day-to-day operations and achieve overall business objectives. Modules Students need to obtain 156 credits in total, of which 131 for in-class courses and 25 for community immersion, computer skill test and thesis. Main Courses YEAR 1 Chinese Etiquette Chinese History Chinese Culture Overview Of China P.E Mathematics Introduction of Chinese Economy Political Economics Entrepreneurship Microeconomics Business Chinese(Intermediate Level) Business Chinese(Advanced Level) Chinese Writing YEAR 2 Liner Algebra Principles of Management Financial Accounting Intermediate Macroeconomics Marketing Industrial Organization Probability Theory & Statistics Computer Application in Economic Management Operations Management Corporate Finance Human Resource Management Strategy Management YEAR 3 Philosophy Organizational Behavior Modern Enterprise Theory Supply-Chain Management Entrepreneurial Management Scientific Management Method Seminar on Business Administration YEAR 4 Management Simulation for International Enterprise Entrepreneurial Marketing Entrepreneurship & Venture Capital Thesis *The courses above are subject to change. Please refer to the syllabus after registration. Career Paths A field as popular and diverse as business administration enables students to seek many different employment opportunities, including general and business management, financial management, administration, business operation. Alternatively,some students decide to take their education one step further with a Master’s degree in business administration or a related discipline like marketing or human resources.
